description: Weekly social run club, every Tuesday at 7 PM. A 45-minute timed run at your own pace: walk, jog or run, any skill level is encouraged. Everyone is welcome, all you need to do is show up. Free.
location_address: 3300 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
location_name: Bluff Park (meet at Coronado Ave and Ocean Blvd, by the stairs)
title: Tuesday Social Run

description: Outdoor yoga on the grassy bluff overlooking the ocean, every day at 11 AM, year-round. Offered with no required donation (cash and electronic donations welcomed). Beginners, friends, family, kids and leashed dogs are invited.
location_name: Bluff at Ocean Blvd and Junipero Ave (Bixby Park Annex)
title: Yoga on the Bluff

description: Recreational pickup soccer almost every Sunday since 2018. Meet at 7:15 AM, game starts around 7:30. No slide tackles, balls, cones, goals and pinnies provided, everyone rotates as keeper. $1 fee per player (Venmo, Zelle, PayPal or cash). RSVP on the Meetup page: games are for RSVP-list members.
location_address: 5157 E Centralia St, Long Beach, CA 90808
title: Early Bird Sunday Soccer

description: Jiu jitsu open mat every Saturday, 10:00 to 11:30 AM. Everyone is welcome, all skill levels, affiliates and non-affiliates. Cost is not stated on the source page, check with the gym for mat fees.
title: Saturday Open Mat

description: Free intro class for first-time climbers, offered daily (weekdays 5 PM, weekends 3 PM). The class is free with a day pass, as a guest, or as a member. Day pass price is on the gym's site.
location_address: 205 E Anaheim St, Long Beach, CA 90813
title: Intro to Bouldering

description: Open play pickleball on Mondays and Wednesdays, 7 to 9 PM, at the Long Beach City College courts. $5 per player. RSVP required, walk-ups are not recommended. Paddle and ball rental available for $10 if you need gear.
location_address: 4901 E Carson St, Long Beach, CA 90808
title: Pickleball Open Play

description: Beginner partner dance class, Wednesdays 7 to 9 PM (salsa 7 to 8, bachata 8 to 9), run as a 4-week session starting at the beginning of each month. Small group, limited leaders and followers. The academy's current page lists $107 per person for the 4-week session; an older page on the same site says $97, so confirm the price when you book.
title: Level 1 Salsa & Bachata

description: Salsa and bachata lessons at 8 PM on Thursdays, followed by DJ and social dancing at 9 PM. 18+. Pricing is unclear: one listing shows from $12.51 while the organizer's own video says lessons are free when you sign up through Eventbrite, so check the source page before you go.
title: Salsa & Bachata Thursdays at Olé

description: Free salsa and bachata night every Thursday at 7 PM at The Bungalow in Marina Pacifica, per the organizer's Eventbrite listing.
location_address: 6400 E Pacific Coast Hwy, Long Beach, CA 90803
title: Free Salsa & Bachata Night at The Bungalow

description: Beginner pole and dance class with Dani, Mondays at 6 PM (a second beginner pole class runs Thursdays at 6 PM). Classes are free with a day pass, as a guest, or as a member. Day pass price is on the gym's site.
location_address: 205 E Anaheim St, Long Beach, CA 90813
title: Beginner Pole / Dance

description: All-day Saturday Commander play at a WPN Premium game store. The store runs trading card game events all week (Magic, Pokémon, Lorcana and more), with entry fees from $5 to $27 depending on the event; Saturday Commander Fest is $8. Note: the store's street address is in Signal Hill, the enclave surrounded by Long Beach.
title: Commander Fest: Saturday TCG Play

description: Friendly, non-competitive board game night every Wednesday at 6 PM in the private room upstairs. Multiple tables of games, and you can bring a game to teach. 21+. No ticket price; everyone buys at least one drink to support the venue (mocktails available).
title: Board Game Night at The Wicked Wolf

description: Casual chess every Tuesday at 7 PM, around 30 players, blitz, rapid and casual games. Absolute beginners to seasoned players, all ages and ratings. Free to play with free parking and no membership fees. Extra boards and clocks are available if you do not bring your own.
location_address: 233 E Anaheim St, Long Beach, CA 90813
title: Long Beach Chess Club

description: Monthly board and card game afternoon at the Unitarian Universalist Church of Long Beach, near CSULB. Bring a game you would like to play. The group's Saturday pattern has shifted over time, so check the Meetup page for the latest date before heading out.
location_address: 5450 E Atherton St, Long Beach, CA 90815
location_name: Unitarian Universalist Church of Long Beach
title: Board Games at UUCLB

description: Monthly vintage flea market running since 1982: 800+ vendors across 20 acres at Veterans Stadium, every item at least 20 years old. Every 3rd Sunday, rain or shine. General admission $10 (6:30 AM to 2 PM), early admission $15 from 5:30 AM, kids under 12 free, free parking. Admission is cash only at the box office.
location_address: 4901 E Conant St, Long Beach, CA 90808
title: Long Beach Antique Market

description: Themed night bike ride on the night of the full moon, every month. Meet at 7:30 PM, ride starts at 8 PM. About 10 miles at a chill, slow pace (8 to 10 mph). Costumes and lights encouraged, and the group usually ends at a local bar or restaurant. All are welcome.
title: Moonlight Mash: Full Moon Bike Ride

description: Monthly family bike ride through Bixby Knolls: a relaxed 4 to 4.5 mile ride welcoming riders of all ages and skill levels, with themed editions through the year. Meet in the back parking lot of Pixie Toys at 11 AM. Free.
title: Kidical Mass Family Bike Ride

description: Weekly queer pickup soccer, Sundays 10 AM to noon at Bixby Park. All skill levels welcome, no pressure. For queer women, trans, nonbinary and gender-nonconforming folks. The host sometimes drops the exact meetup spot the day before, so check the source page before you go.
title: Dyke Soccer Long Beach
